evals.name: basic-bake-demo6-json
evals.prompt: can you generate a scene from tests/replay/demo7_1-rig-layout.json
evals.expected_output: Runs json_to_scene.py on tests/replay/demo7_1-rig-layout.json with --verify, prints VERIFY OK with entity counts, and flags the layout-only caveat (no trains). Does NOT hand-write a new converter.

evals.name: named-output-bake
evals.prompt: bake tests/replay/demo7_1-rig-layout.json into a python scene file called yard_demo.py with scene id yard_demo
evals.expected_output: Runs the baker writing to yard_demo.py with --scene-id yard_demo and --verify; reports the output path, SCENE_ID, and VERIFY OK counts.

evals.name: stale-json-match-current-scene
evals.prompt: convert demo7_1-rig-layout.json into a .py scene, but I want it to match the CURRENT demo7_1 (I edited the scene by hand since)
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that tests/replay/demo7_1-rig-layout.json is stale vs demo7_1.py, so serializes the live demo7_1 network (to_layout_dict) to a JSON first and bakes THAT, rather than the stale file. Reports counts and the layout-only caveat.
